src: query glyph cells s above the first separator row
dst: reference table glyph cells d between the separator rows
match_cond: s and d have the same color and same 3x3 glyph shape within their 5x5 cell
transform: green-fill the background inside each matched d cell; if all query glyphs match cells forming one complete table row or column, also green-fill the query band and bottom verdict band, otherwise fill only the bottom verdict band red
